title: Holds, Closures, Declines and Opt-Outs in the PAP Supply Replenishment Program
content:
## Rule

An active enrollment in the PAP Supply Replenishment Program goes on hold, with the matching hold reason, when:

1. the patient is an inpatient or in skilled nursing (where the schedule stops shipments during such a stay);
2. the supply order is older than the schedule's supply-order validity months;
3. the proof of continued use is older than the schedule's proof-of-continued-use months;
4. the primary coverage cannot be verified; or
5. the Summit Ridge device record is returned.

No item ships during a hold, and the period of an item does not pause during it. The hold is released when its reason is cleared.

An enrollment on hold is closed only after the hold has lasted the schedule's maximum hold days, counting calendar days from the day after the hold date with the boundary day included.

The patient may decline or opt out at any time by their own confirmation; items already shipped are not returned.

## The closing date

The clock starts from the hold date recorded on the enrollment. Day 1 is the day after the hold date; the enrollment may be closed on the day that completes the maximum hold days, and not before.

*Boundary cases (hypothetical, a 30-day maximum):* a hold dated the 1st of a 31-day month. Day 1 is the 2nd, and day 30 is the 31st. Closing on the 31st meets the rule; closing on the 30th is one day early.

## Effects during a hold

| Question | Answer under this rule |
|---|---|
| Does any item ship while the enrollment is on hold? | no |
| Does an item's period stop running during the hold? | no — it does not pause |
| When is the hold released? | when its reason is cleared |
| Are items already shipped returned when the patient opts out? | no |

## Basis Q&A

**A patient on hold for an expired order asks to leave the program. Is the patient's own confirmation enough?** Yes. The patient may opt out at any time by their own confirmation.

**An enrollment has been on hold for fewer days than the schedule's maximum. May it be closed for the hold?** No. It is closed only after the hold has lasted the maximum hold days.
